text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you, both of you. I'm truly 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We're having a party with everyone today! 
Mom and Dad said they're waiting with a 
whole feast ready!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I can't wait. I wonder if they'll have 
the super sweet cakes Vivlos loves? Today 
is special, so let's eat as much as we 
want.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'm sooooo excitedâª Right, 
Cheval-chi?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—So you're participating too, Cheval. 
Thank you. But please don't push yourself 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yeah... But... at least for today, 
I'll stay until the end, really...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! We even got your present 
together, you know! We went to so many 
shops just the two of us! Right?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —! Just the two of us, together...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Right... ――Thank you, now I'm looking 
forward to it even more."
